title: Arninis's Chunker
description: a lil minigame i got bored so i made it
body:
Soo.. this is Arninis's chunker a short style minigame of trying to dodge holes in youur world! while trying to not fall in!

it might be easy but if you want it to harder tell me how many seconds it should delete a chunk and i might upload it as a new version and it would say it as the file name!

the first ever mod i had made! i hope this would be good for everyone!
